The '''Engineer''' is a [[villager]] profession that sells redstone components in bulk. It replaces the {{MCW|Armorer|armorer}}, and its job site block is the {{ItemLink|Blast Furnace}}. It sells no armor and buys nothing.

== Trades ==
{{Data/Trades/Engineer}}
All trades can be used 999 times before restocking, and every level offers all of its trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/armorer/level_1.json}}</ref>

* From Novice to Expert the engineer sells stacks of 32 or 64 redstone components for 1 obol each, using the pack's names for the redstone blocks ([[Electric Comparator]], [[Electric Repeater]], [[Electric Block]], [[Electric Lamp]], [[Copper Eye]]).
* At Master level it sells the [[Bundles#Geothermal Bundle|Geothermal Bundle]], a bundle holding 4 [[Flowstone|flowstone]], 4 [[Speleothem|speleothems]], 4 lava buckets, 4 cauldrons and 8 glass.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/5/lava_kit.json}}</ref>

Like every villager, an engineer that has been traded with also buys its [[favorite food]] once.

== Trivia ==
* The Geothermal Bundle's internal name is <code>lava_kit</code>. Its contents are the blocks needed to fill cauldrons with lava from dripping speleothems, as in a vanilla {{MCW|Pointed Dripstone|pointed dripstone}} lava farm.
* Internally the profession is still <code>minecraft:armorer</code>; only its displayed name changes.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
